title: Putin Praises Trump’s Ukraine Peace Push After Historic Trilateral With Xi
text:
Russian President Vladimir Putin said US President Donald Trump is “genuinely committed to resolving conflicts, including the one in Ukraine,” following their historic trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen.
Speaking after the talks, Putin expressed optimism about the future of US-Russia relations, saying Trump was sincerely interested in improving bilateral ties across multiple areas. The Russian leader also noted that Moscow hopes the US president’s constructive approach will continue as both sides work through complex international challenges.
